data.name: SelectTBNOnCD
data.value: Select what difficulties TBN should be used on CD:

data.name: UseShadowWallFirst
data.value: Use ShadowWall/Shadowed Vigil First

data.name: UseShadowWallFirstDesc
data.value: Uses ShadowWall/Shadowed Vigil before Rampart

data.name: AlignDarkMind
data.value: Align Dark Mind

data.name: AlignDarkMindDesc
data.value: Tries to align Dark Mind with Rampart for tankbusters. (as it is lesser than Shadow Wall/Shadowed Vigil)

data.name: UnmendStandard
data.value: Unmend (Standard)

data.name: UnmendStandardDesc
data.value:
Will use Unmend to pull, if selected. Should start at -1.0 seconds.
Recommended by The Balance.

data.name: Shadowstride
data.value: Shadowstride

data.name: ShadowstrideDesc
data.value: Will use Shadowstride to pull, if selected. Should start at -0.7 seconds.

data.name: HardSlash
data.value: Hard Slash

data.name: HardSlashDesc
data.value: Will use Hard Slash to pull, if selected. Should start at 0.0 seconds.

data.name: WillUseCooldownsRegardless
data.value: Will use Cooldowns regardless of the type of enemy.

data.name: OnlyBosses
data.value: Only Bosses

data.name: WillUseCooldownsOnlyBoss
data.value: Will try to use Cooldowns only when you're in a boss fight. (Note: don't rely on this 100%, square sometimes marks enemies inconsistently)

data.name: SendOnCooldown
data.value: Send on Cooldown

data.name: SendOnCooldownDesc
data.value: Will use Delirium usages on cooldown. Recommended.

data.name: TieToLivingShadow
data.value: Tie to Living Shadow (for manual control)

data.name: TieToLivingShadowDesc
data.value:
Will require Living Shadow to have been recently used before using even-minute Deliriums. (Odd-minute Delirium usage will proceed on cooldown)
ONLY recommended if you want more manual control. (Does not apply to Blood Weapon)

data.name: UseHalfway
data.value: Use Halfway

data.name: UseHalfwayDesc
data.value: Will use Salt and Darkness about halfway through Salted Earth's duration, after more important oGCDs. Recommended.

data.name: UseInstantly
data.value: Use Instantly (for heavy movement)

data.name: UseInstantlyDesc
data.value: Will use Salt and Darkness as soon as possible (outside of the opener). Only Recommended for heavy movement fights, and only if you know you can fit your other oGCDs in.

data.name: UseInstantlyAoEDesc
data.value: Will use Salt and Darkness as soon as possible.

data.name: ManaSaveTBNAlways
data.value: Mana to always save for TBN (0 = Use All). Spent freely until you have The Blackest Night.

data.name: SecondsBeforeBurst
data.value: Seconds before Burst to save (allowing capping)

data.name: ManaSaveTBN
data.value: Mana to save for TBN (0 = Use All). Spent freely until you have The Blackest Night.

data.name: DarkMissionaryRequirePartyDesc
data.value: Will not use Dark Missionary unless there are 2 or more party members.

data.name: DarkMissionaryUseAlwaysDesc
data.value: Will not require a party for Dark Missionary.

data.name: UseAtOrAbove
data.value: # to use at or above
